AllowGrenadesThroughShields.label: Allow Grenades Through Shields
AllowGrenadesThroughShields.description: Allows grenades to pass through shield bubbles.

SafeRestLocation.label: Safe Rest Location
SafeRestLocation.description: Pawns (including animals) will only rest/sleep in safe locations without hazards like fire, pollution, or gas. They'll also avoid doors.

EnhanceArtilleryMarkers.label: Artillery Marker Enhancement
EnhanceArtilleryMarkers.description: Artillery and mortars will prioritize firing at targets with artillery markers. Other turrets gain a small accuracy boost when firing at marked targets.

AutoAvoidProximityActivators.label: Auto Avoid Proximity Activators
AutoAvoidProximityActivators.description: Pawns automatically avoid mechanoid proximity activators during pathfinding, similar to how they avoid fire. Prevents accidental triggering of dormant mechanoid clusters.

BuildAtCorners.label: Build at Corners
BuildAtCorners.description: Allow colonists to construct blueprints and frames placed at wall corners (the center of a + shape). In vanilla, such blueprints can be delivered to but never finished because no pawn can reach them through the diagonal.

AutoTargetMarksOnNonHostile.label: Auto Target Artillery Markers on Non-Hostile Entities
AutoTargetMarksOnNonHostile.description: Whether artillery and mortars should automatically target artillery markers on non-hostile entities (e.g., neutral animals or visitors).
